name: Inventory (example)
description: A complete, minimal example manifest showing every field an extension module can declare. Disabled by default so it never appears in a real workspace unless a self-hoster turns it on.

settings.label: Reorder threshold
settings.description: Flag an item as low stock once its quantity falls to or below this number.

settings.label: Default warehouse
settings.description: Where a newly received item is assumed to be stored.

settings.label: Propose reorders automatically
settings.description: When on, low-stock items get a reorder task proposed for approval instead of waiting to be noticed.
